title: Automated vendor questionnaire answer suggester with product-impact tagging and evidence bundler
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Large enterprise customers submit long vendor security/compliance questionnaires (VQAs/RFIs/DPA checklists). The intake team spends significant time mapping each ask to product capabilities, assembling the current evidence (SOC2 reports, encryption docs, deployment options), and estimating product work to close non-standard asks. Goal: build an automated reviewer that ingests a vendor questionnaire (XLS/PDF/plain text), proposes candidate answers from a curated library, tags each item with product-impact signals (requires engineering work | config | policy | legal), and produces a downloadable evidence kit plus an SLA/effort estimator for negotiation. This reduces turnaround time for first responses and surfaces risky asks earlier to PM/Eng/Security. Scope: - Import/parse questionnaires and map questions to canonical taxonomy. - Suggest answer text from a managed answer library with confidence score. - Tag each question with one or more product-impact labels and a quick effort estimate (T-shirt: none/low/medium/high). - Produce a compiled evidence bundle (links to SOC2, ISO docs, DPA clauses, KMS design, network diagrams). - Provide UI for triage reviewer to accept/modify answers and push a draft response to the customer. - Export final bundle as a customer-facing zip and a PR-like change for product backlog if remediation is required. Out-of-scope: auto-signing/approval by legal, full remediation pipelines. Success metrics: - Reduce average first-response time for vendor questionnaires from current baseline (tracked in intake dashboard) by 50% within first 3 months. - >70% of suggested answers accepted without edits by triage reviewers. - Decrease time engineering spends on classification and evidence hunting by 60% per questionnaire. Acceptance criteria enumerated below.
acceptance_criteria: System accepts XLSX/CSV/PDF input and extracts questions with >85% accuracy on a representative test sample.
For a sample of 200 real past questionnaire items, suggested answers match reviewer-accepted answers >=70% of the time.
Each item is tagged with at least one product-impact label and an effort estimate; tags match human labels >=75% of the time.
Triage UI allows inline edit/approve and exports a customer-ready ZIP containing answers, evidence links, and a changelog.
Evidence bundler can reference and attach SOC2 summary, recent penetration test date, relevant DPA text snippets, and encryption-at-rest details on demand.
Metrics emitted to console: avg response time, acceptance rate, time saved per questionnaire; dashboards updated within 24 hours of first deploy.

notes: Trade-offs: Using an LLM-based extractor speeds mapping but increases surface area for PII — mitigations include local redaction and ephemeral parse storage.
We should start with a managed answer library (editable by PMs/Solutions/Legal) to keep suggestions consistent and auditable.
Long-term: surfaced product-impact tags should feed into a backlog auto-creator with templated remediation tickets for ENG/Infra teams.
Metric collection will require Console instrumentation tags (intake.questionnaire.*) — coordinate with Observability team early.
